title: T1 turning plate: turns the whole stack 90 deg (pose: turn 0 deg, lift 0.0)
cups: 3 x DP-S30, one per stone: (x, table z at lift 0) = (0, 80), (70, 165), (0, 250)
turning_axis: x 0, table 165 at lift 0 (= middle stone centre)
drive: MG996R + round horn, 22T -> 33T m1.25 (90 deg plate = 135 deg servo)
joint: hollow shaft: tube Ø15 x 1 x 54 (copper / alu / steel) in 2 x 6002-2RS; hub + rear collar = coupler clamps
pneumatics: pumps + valves in the robot; 3 tubes Ø4 through the hollow shaft
lift_turn: lift = 160 sin t + 165 cos t + 5 - 165: 5 at t 0, peak 69.8 at t 44 deg, 0 at t 90

tubes_to_robot.REF_TUBE_TOP_TO_ROBOT: 116 mm to z 230, min bend R12.0
tubes_to_robot.REF_TUBE_MID_TO_ROBOT: 139 mm to z 230, min bend R11.7
tubes_to_robot.REF_TUBE_BOT_TO_ROBOT: 182 mm to z 230, min bend R12.0

fits: A+B front (|x| <= 65.5 at the plate, door units from 66) and B alone (back)
